provenance.stage: Lifecycle from the DataForSEO 7-day Google Trends curve collected after each scan (pulse.decide.lifecycle); 'unknown' = no usable curve (none collected, too few points, or a flat-zero curve) — each item's stage_note says which.
provenance.rank: National board rank (India Pulse ordering) per scan.
provenance.heat: India Pulse heat, 0–100, from Google's Trending-now volume, growth, breadth and freshness — in the LATEST scan each trend was seen in; in_last_scan false = it was not on the newest scan of the window (last_scan says which).
